cases.name: Katherine "Kathy" Geren
cases.about: "She was real quiet and shy unless you knew her, then she was funny. She was sweet. I mean, she was just a strong, independent, amazing mother and grandmother, and she was just wonderful," (her granddaughter Elly) Yandell said.
cases.narrative: On 4/13/2026, their bodies were found during a welfare check.
